name: toastmasters-zoom-timer
description: Browser-based Toastmasters speech timer with auto-changing stoplight virtual background.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:sh && npm run lint:fallow
scripts.health: npm run coverage && fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only
scripts.health:gate: npm run coverage && fallow audit --gate new-only --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json
